title: Idle World: Trucks
author: donkaike
selftext:
Idle World Trucks is a semi-idle trucking tycoon set on a real map. Brazil is the first country, and it's already big:



\- 366 real cities across 12 states plus the Federal District

\- 67,000+ km of real highways (371 named roads like BR-116 and BR-101), with real elevation and road surface

\- 381 toll plazas, placed where they really are

\- 65 cargo types, 48 of them tradeable: buy low in one city, sell high in another

\- 5 body types (dry van, reefer, grain body, stake body and lowboy), each with its own cargo

\- 6 truck sizes, from the "toco" (single-axle rigid) to the 9-axle road train, in 3 brands

\- 140 parts (engine, gearbox, chassis, tires, fuel tank, cab and bodies), new or used, and each one rolls its own stats, so no two engines are quite the same; they wear out and need repairs

\- 13 skills to unlock, like Long haul, Coupling and Hazmat

\- Driver rest, diesel stops, flat tires, police checks, fog and roadworks

\- 11 languages, metric or imperial



You pick the job, the truck and the route, dispatch, and the trip runs in real time even with the app closed. Later you hire drivers and run a fleet.



\*\*Roadmap:\*\* Brazil is only the starting point.



\- Heading south to Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay, then up through Central America, with the goal of reaching North America within the next month

\- The whole world, crossable by truck

\- Advanced multiplayer

\- Truck customization

\- Trinkets for your cab

\- And more as the community asks for it



I'm a solo dev from Brazil, and I need 12 testers for 14 days for the Play Store closed test:



1. Join the test group: [https://groups.google.com/g/magiccoffeegames](https://groups.google.com/g/magiccoffeegames)

2. Become a tester: [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.donkaike.idle\_world\_trucks](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.donkaike.idle_world_trucks)

3. Install: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.donkaike.idle\_world\_trucks](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.donkaike.idle_world_trucks)



I'd especially love feedback from people who know trucks: does anything feel wrong or unrealistic (fuel consumption, speeds, cargo per body type)? And the cities: is anything missing, misplaced or off?

  
For now we used IA for make some images, but It can be disabled on settings and use only icons!
